riskCategories.description: Risks related to payment terms, pricing, and financial obligations

flags.title: Unlimited Liability Exposure
flags.description: Contract contains unlimited liability provisions without caps or limitations

flags.title: Automatic Price Escalation
flags.description: Automatic price increases without negotiation or market adjustment

flags.title: Unfavorable Payment Terms
flags.description: Short payment windows or high late payment penalties

riskCategories.description: Risks related to contract termination rights and obligations

flags.title: Unilateral Termination Rights
flags.description: One party has significantly more favorable termination rights than the other

flags.title: Short Notice Period
flags.description: Insufficient notice period for termination creates business uncertainty

flags.title: Automatic Renewal Without Notice
flags.description: Contract automatically renews without adequate notice period

riskCategories.description: Risks related to ownership and use of intellectual property

flags.title: Broad IP Assignment
flags.description: Overly broad assignment of intellectual property rights without carve-outs

flags.title: No Pre-Existing IP Protection
flags.description: Failure to protect pre-existing intellectual property and tools

flags.title: Restrictive License Terms
flags.description: Limitations on using general methodologies or tools post-termination

riskCategories.description: Risks related to non-compete and non-solicitation provisions

flags.title: Broad Geographic Restriction
flags.description: Non-compete covers overly broad geographic area

flags.title: Extended Duration
flags.description: Non-compete extends for unreasonably long period

flags.title: Broad Industry Restriction
flags.description: Non-compete restricts entire industry rather than specific services

riskCategories.description: Risks related to indemnification obligations and scope

flags.title: One-Sided Indemnification
flags.description: Indemnification obligations are not mutual or balanced

flags.title: Broad Indemnification Scope
flags.description: Indemnification covers matters beyond party's reasonable control

flags.title: Third-Party Claims
flags.description: Indemnification extends to third-party claims without limitations

riskCategories.description: Risks related to dispute resolution mechanisms

flags.title: Mandatory Arbitration
flags.description: Required arbitration eliminates right to jury trial

flags.title: Unfavorable Venue
flags.description: Dispute resolution venue is inconvenient or unfavorable

flags.title: Limited Discovery Rights
flags.description: Arbitration or dispute resolution limits discovery or evidence gathering

high.label: High Risk
high.description: Requires immediate attention and likely negotiation

medium.label: Medium Risk
medium.description: Should be reviewed and potentially modified
